title: Kubernetes operator: create, scale, upgrade
narrative: As a platform engineer, I want to declare a DS-CORE cluster in Kubernetes and have it ready, scaled and upgraded automatically.

evals.name: cluster lifecycle on 3 K8s versions with harness assertions
evals.command: make -C operator e2e K8S_VERSIONS=latest3 TESTS='TestCreateReady10m TestScale3to5 TestRollingUpgrade' HARNESS_ASSERT='zero-errors,upgrade-no-failed-interval,upgrade-p99-factor=1.5'
